annotations.title: Entité légale mondiale du registre LEI (GLEIF)

description: Identify a legal entity anywhere in the world in the official GLEIF registry of Legal Entity Identifiers (open data, CC0), either by its 20-character LEI, or by country (ISO alpha-2) plus national registration number (for France, a SIREN). Returns the legal name, entity status (ACTIVE or INACTIVE), legal form code, registered address, business register and number, creation date, the LEI registration record (status, issue, update and renewal dates, corroboration level), the declared direct and ultimate parent (LEI, name, country) and stable signal codes with a link to the official record (LEI_ACTIF, LEI_NON_RENOUVELE, ENTITE_INACTIVE, ENTITE_REMPLACEE, DONNEES_PEU_CORROBOREES, GROUPE_PARENT_ULTIME_IDENTIFIE), signed with an Ed25519 attestation. For a French entity with a SIREN it also gives the paid routes to check it. No global verdict: most companies have no LEI, so a missing LEI is not a negative signal. Use exactly one mode: `lei`, or `pays` + `immatriculation`. `parents: "non"` skips the two parent lookups (default "oui"). If several LEI share a registration number, the most relevant one is returned and `correspondances` tells how many exist (then pass `lei` to be exact). No personal data: sole proprietors (natural persons) are excluded, as an entity and as a parent; their LEI answers as not found. When to use another tool: for a French company, verifier_entreprise (full KYB) and procedures_collectives (insolvency) are the reference checks; use this one for foreign counterparties or to map a corporate group. Errors (never charged): invalid input (bad LEI check digits, both modes at once, bad country) is rejected before any payment request; an entity absent from the registry (or excluded) or GLEIF being unreachable returns an error and is not settled. Payment: $0.01 per call via x402 (USDC on Base). No account or API key.

immatriculation.description: National registration number (3 to 40 characters; a SIREN for FR), used with pays.

parents.description: "non" skips the direct and ultimate parent lookups (default "oui").

pays.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the registered office (FR, DE, GB…), used with immatriculation.
